description.en: Cursor IDE provider with Connect-RPC code carried by the plugin.
description.zh: 由插件自带 Connect-RPC 代码的 Cursor IDE Provider。

docs.en: Import an account from Cursor IDE. Request signing, protobuf framing, usage and model hooks execute from this package.
docs.zh: 从 Cursor IDE 导入账号；请求签名、Protobuf 帧、用量与模型钩子均由本包执行。

description.en: Copy the access token and Machine ID from Cursor's local state.
description.zh: 从 Cursor 本地状态中复制访问令牌与 Machine ID。

help_text.zh: 取自 Cursor state.vscdb 中的 storage.serviceMachineId。
